definitions: A platform or compartment housed in a shaft for raising and lowering people or things to different floors.
An act of transporting someone in a vehicle, typically free of charge.
A feeling of increased optimism or cheerfulness.
The upward force exerted by the air on an aerofoil or other body moving through it.
examples: Take the lift to the fourth floor.
Can you give me a lift to the station?
The good news gave her a real lift.
The wings provide enough lift for takeoff.
